scope.domain: Non-browser system quality: API, contracts, performance, chaos, security, mobile, accessibility, data, cloud, observability, CI/CD, networking, resilience, compliance, and production testing
scope.exclusions: Browser frameworks and unit-language topics assigned to other article-factory mining tracks
scope.selectionRule: Every survivor has a distinct searcher need, two or more repository evidence files, official documentation, enough depth for a 3000-word article, and no prior or self collision.

collisionMethod.slug: Reject exact slug matches and either-direction slug containment against inventory, selected, reserves, prior mining, and this file.
collisionMethod.title: Lowercase titles, remove punctuation and stopwords, then reject overlap above 0.60 using shared tokens divided by the smaller token set.
collisionMethod.primaryKeyword: Reject normalized exact primary keyword matches against inventory, selected, reserves, prior mining, and this file.
collisionMethod.intent: Manually retain only one searcher need per topic and record the excluded adjacent intent in intentBoundary.
